item.title: Quick start propels West Chester East in Ches-Mont quarterfinals
item.description: WESTTOWN — It’s been a couple of years since the West Chester East girls basketball team has made the short trip to West Chester University to participate in the Ches-Mont League Final Four. But, a hot start and two Kaylas took care of that short break. Kayla Cochran and Kayla Holman registered 13 points apiece as the Vikings survived periods of sloppy play to turn back West Chester Rustin, 43-33, in the Ches-Mont League quarterfinals Thursday. item.title: With star contained, balanced scoring leads Shanahan
item.description: DOWNINGTOWN — On a night when star forward Andrew Corcoran was held to just eight points, the Bishop Shanahan boys basketball team got plenty of help from the rest of the roster in a 58-42 victory over Unionville in the Ches-Mont League quarterfinal Thursday.
